Hardware Tool Debug Features by Device
Hardware Tool Debug Features by Device
Information taken from MPLAB X IDE device database files.
Table Headings: See a list of heading descriptions below the table.
Table Cells: To sort the data, use the CSV file in HWToolDebugFeatures.zip.
Color Legend: Green cells: supported; Gray cells: no support; Background color cells: support differs by tool.
Text Legend: Yes or Value: supported; No: no support; N/A: no information in database.
Tool Legend: ICE4 = MPLAB® ICE 4 in-circuit emulator/production programmer, ICD5 = MPLAB® ICD 5 in-circuit debugger/production programmer, ICD4 = MPLAB® ICD 4 in-circuit debugger/production programmer, PK5 = MPLAB PICkit™ 5 in-circuit debugger/production programmer,
PK4 = MPLAB PICkit™ 4 in-circuit debugger/production programmer, Snap = MPLAB Snap in-circuit debugger/development programmer, PKB = MPLAB PICkit™ Basic in-circuit debugger/production programmer, AICE = Atmel-ICE in-circuit debugger/production programmer, as well as Power Debugger.
Legacy Tools: See "G3HWToolDebugFeatures.html" in zip file.
PK4/5 PTG Support: See "PKxPTGSupport.html" in zip file.
